about.heading: Commercial Yoga Studio Build-Out in Langley
about.para1: VV Renovation helped complete a commercial yoga studio renovation in Langley, BC, turning the space into a clean, functional and polished interior for everyday studio use.
about.para2: The project included floor preparation, yoga mat installation, decorative wall panels, storage assembly, finishing details and adjustments around the mirror wall and training areas.

scope.heading: What We Completed
scope.intro: This Langley yoga studio project included structural preparation, drywall and ceiling work, self-leveling, vinyl tile installation, yoga mat installation, decorative wall panels, furniture assembly and detailed finishing around mirrors, baseboards and training areas.

cards.title: Framing, Studs & Drywall
cards.text: Completed framing work using steel/wood studs, then installed drywall to prepare the studio layout for ceiling work, wall finishes and final interior details.

cards.title: Ceiling Work & Studio Preparation
cards.text: Worked on the studio ceiling system and prepared the space for the next finishing stages, including lighting areas, wall connections and clean interior transitions.

cards.title: Self-Leveling & Floor Preparation
cards.text: Prepared the floor with self-leveling before the vinyl tile and yoga mat installation, creating a smoother base for the final studio flooring.

cards.title: Vinyl Tile & Yoga Mat Installation
cards.text: Installed vinyl tiles and yoga mats for the main studio areas, creating a durable training surface suitable for daily yoga, fitness and studio use.

cards.title: Decorative Wall Panels
cards.text: Installed decorative wall panels to add texture, warmth and a more finished interior look to the studio, including feature areas around the training space.

cards.title: Furniture, Shelves & Small Installations
cards.text: Completed storage assembly, furniture installation, shelves, outlet-related details and small handyman tasks needed to make the studio functional and ready for use.

testimonial.quote: We had a great experience working with this renovation company. Everything was very organized, professional, and done in a timely manner. The team worked efficiently, paid attention to details, and the final result turned out really well. We are very happy with the quality of the work and will definitely be using their services again in the future. Highly recommend!
testimonial.author: Jenya

items.question: What type of project was this?
items.answer: This was a commercial yoga studio renovation in Langley, BC. The project included framing, steel and wood studs, drywall, ceiling work, self-leveling, vinyl tile installation, yoga mat installation, decorative wall panels, furniture assembly, shelving, outlet-related details and small finishing work.

items.question: What materials and methods were used in this studio project?
items.answer: The project involved steel and wood studs, drywall, ceiling work, self-leveling floor preparation, vinyl tiles, yoga mats, decorative wall panels, storage furniture, shelves and detailed baseboard adjustments around the mirror wall and mat areas.

items.question: What was the most difficult part of the project?
items.answer: The most difficult part was the baseboard work around the mirror wall and yoga mat areas. The baseboards had been installed before the mirrors and yoga mats were fully completed, so they had to be removed, cut to the correct height and reinstalled section by section.

items.question: How long did the yoga studio renovation take?
items.answer: This project took approximately 1.5 to 2 months, depending on the full scope, coordination with other trades, installation stages and finishing details.

items.question: Do you renovate other commercial studios or fitness spaces?
items.answer: Yes. VV Renovation can help with commercial interior renovation, fitness studio build-outs, drywall, floor preparation, decorative wall panels, flooring, finishing details and other renovation work across the Greater Vancouver Area.

items.question: How much does a similar studio renovation cost?
items.answer: The cost depends on the size of the space, existing condition, framing, drywall, ceiling work, flooring, yoga mats, decorative wall panels, furniture installation and the amount of detailed finishing required. The best way to price a similar project is to request a site visit and free estimate.
